about.title: The Vibe
about.subtitle: Where Industrial Elegance Meets Tropical Productivity
about.description: We've transformed a legendary fine dining restaurant into Pattaya's most inspiring workspace. The high ceilings remain. The warm lighting stays. The unique layout persists. But now, it's optimized for deep work, collaboration, and building something extraordinary.

highlights.title: Unique Ambiance
highlights.description: Former fine dining space with preserved character—warm mood lighting, distinct architectural details, and an atmosphere you won't find anywhere else.

highlights.title: Community Focus
highlights.description: This isn't just desks and chairs. It's a curated network of digital nomads, entrepreneurs, and remote professionals building the future together.

highlights.title: Phase 1: Rapid Launch
highlights.description: We're moving fast. Early members get founding rates and the chance to shape what Pattaya Space becomes. Join us at the ground floor.

tiers.name: Hot Desk
tiers.description: Flexible seating in the main hall
